projectDescription: Recreate the public-facing Sneha Fancy & General Stores website in the supplied reference, suitable for hosting from GitHub. Reference: https://sneha-fancy-morampallibanjar.lovable.app/

reference.observed: A responsive, single-page local-store website with gallery, product categories, LIC insurance and Fino banking information, business story, address, phone, WhatsApp, maps, and Google review QR.

services.name: Storefront website
services.description: Responsive informational storefront based on the reference site, with contact, WhatsApp, telephone, map, and gallery interactions.

questions.question: Which language should the storefront use?
questions.rationale: A modern static frontend is suitable for GitHub Pages; TypeScript improves maintainability.

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Recommended for a maintainable modern frontend.

questions.question: Which frontend framework should be used?
questions.rationale: The reference appears to be a modern component-based single-page site; React can be built as a static site for GitHub Pages.

options.label: React
options.description: Recommended for a component-based static storefront.

questions.question: What should the website include beyond reproducing the reference’s gallery, store information, product/service sections, and call/WhatsApp/map links? In particular, should it remain an informational site, or do you need online product listings, ordering/cart, or store-admin features?
questions.recommendedChoice: Recreate the informational storefront and its existing contact links; no checkout or admin features.
questions.answer: Recreate the informational storefront and its existing contact links; no checkout or admin features.
questions.rationale: The supplied reference is an informational business website and does not show a cart, checkout, or administration workflow.

questions.question: What persistent data or storage does this application need?
questions.rationale: The reference presents static business content and external contact links; no user accounts, transactions, uploads, or persisted application data are evident.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use static content and external contact links; no application persistence.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Store or serve images and other files.

questions.question: Do users need to sign in to use application features?
questions.rationale: The reference is a public storefront and does not expose sign-in or account-specific features.

options.label: No
options.description: The public website is accessible without signing in.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users must sign in to use application features.

questions.question: Is GitHub Pages your preferred hosting target, and should deployment be configured as a static GitHub Pages site?
questions.recommendedChoice: Yes — static website hosted with GitHub Pages.
questions.answer: Yes — static website hosted with GitHub Pages.
questions.rationale: You asked to host the application in GitHub; GitHub Pages is suitable if this remains an informational static storefront.

options.label: Yes — GitHub Pages
options.description: Publish a static site from this GitHub repository.

options.label: GitHub repository only
options.description: Put the code on GitHub; choose the hosting provider later.

options.label: Other hosting
options.description: Use another hosting provider or deployment approach.
